name: Hospital AI Automation — Appointments + WhatsApp Support + Voice Calls + Reports + Feedback

parameters.content:
## 🏥 Hospital AI Automation — End-to-End Workflow (5 Use Cases)
Priority order match: 1) Appointment+Follow-up  2) WhatsApp AI Support  3) AI Voice Calling (via apna Server API)  4) Reports/Prescription  5) Feedback+Review

**IMPORTANT — is JSON ko n8n me import karne ke baad:**
1. Settings gear (top-right) → Variables/Environment me neeche di gayi ENV VARS set karo (ya n8n instance ke .env me).
2. WhatsApp send/AI Agent tool nodes me koi bhi red/warning aaye to sirf URL/credential dobara select karo — logic touch mat karo.
3. Sabse neeche " SEPARATE ERROR WORKFLOW" section hai — usse copy karke NAYI workflow me paste karo, phir is main workflow ki Settings → Error Workflow me select karo.
4. Supabase me neeche di gayi tables banao (chat reply me poora SQL diya hai).
5. Meta Business Manager me WhatsApp message TEMPLATES approve karwao (naam is workflow me hi likhe hain — chat reply me exact text diya hai).

Is ek hi workflow ke andar 4 trigger points hain (independent, ek doosre ko block nahi karte): WhatsApp Webhook, Voice-Call-Status Webhook, Report-Ready Webhook, aur 3 Schedule Triggers.

### 1️⃣ + 2️⃣ SECTION A — WhatsApp Inbound Router + AI Agent (Appointment Booking + 24x7 Patient Support)
Single entry point ek hi Webhook path "/whatsapp-webhook" par (GET = Meta verification handshake, POST = actual messages).
Har inbound message pehle classify hota hai: (a) pending feedback ka 1-5 rating reply? → Feedback Handler | (b) baaki sab → AI Agent (booking + FAQ + escalation).
AI Agent Note: neeche AI Agent ke paas 8 tools hain, ek dedicated system prompt (Hinglish support) aur per-patient memory hai — poora detail agent ke paas wale chhote sticky note me hai.

parameters.content:
### 🤖 AI AGENT NOTE — "Patient WhatsApp AI Agent"
**Model:** Google Gemini Chat Model (credential = Gemini/PaLM API key). Agar Gemini node red dikhe, isi ai_languageModel connection par OpenAI Chat Model node se swap kar sakte ho — baaki kuch touch nahi karna padega.
**Memory:** per-patient (sessionKey = patient ka WhatsApp number) — 20 messages tak context yaad rakhta hai.
**Tools (8):** Doctor/Dept info • Doctor's booked slots • Book appointment • Reschedule • Cancel • My report status • Request AI voice call • Escalate to front desk. Har tool ka naam+description hi model ka "menu" hai — inhe mat generic karna.
**Security:** patient_id/phone tools me hidden(plumbed) hai, agent kabhi doosre patient ka data touch nahi kar sakta — agent sirf apna khud ka appointment book/cancel/reschedule kar sakta hai.
**Guardrails:** system prompt me clearly likha hai — koi diagnosis/medicine advice nahi, sirf appointment + info + routing.
**maxIterations:** 25 (multi-tool agent, low default bahut jaldi "max iterations" error deta).
**Optional 9th tool:** Supabase MCP Client Tool — aapke connected Supabase MCP (mcp.supabase.com) se seedha live DB access deta hai. Yeh naya n8n node hai — agar import ke baad iska field name match na kare to bas isse delete kar do, baaki 8 tools se poora system chal jayega.

parameters.toolDescription: Returns the full list of doctors with their department, consultation fee, working days and working hours. Use this FIRST whenever the patient asks about departments, doctors, timings, fees, or before booking an appointment (to get the correct doctor_id). Takes no parameters — always returns the complete list.

Returns already-booked appointment times for one doctor on one date, so you can compare against that doctor's working hours (from Get Hospital and Doctor Info) and suggest a free slot to the patient. Always call this before Book Appointment.

## Tumhara scope
1. Appointment book karna, reschedule karna, cancel karna.
2. Doctor/department/timing/fee/location jaise common sawaalon ke jawab dena.
3. Patient ka apna report/appointment status batana.
4. Agar patient bole "mujhe call chahiye" ya complex/urgent lage, to voice-call tool use karo.
5. Kuch bhi jo tum handle nahi kar sakte (clinical judgement, complaints, billing dispute, emergency) — turant Escalate tool use karo aur patient ko bata do ki team jald contact karegi.

## SAKHT RULES (kabhi mat todna)
- Kabhi bhi diagnosis, dawai ki dose, ya medical advice mat do. Har clinical sawaal par bolo: "Yeh sawaal doctor se discuss karna zaroori hai" aur appointment book karne ka offer do.
- Agar koi emergency jaisa lage (chest pain, severe bleeding, breathing issue, etc.) turant bolo: "Yeh emergency lag rahi hai, kripya turant nearest emergency room jaayein ya ambulance call karein" — aur Escalate tool bhi turant call karo.
- Appointment book/reschedule/cancel karne se pehle patient se department/doctor aur preferred date/time confirm karo — kabhi khud se guess karke book mat karo.
- Kabhi kisi report ka secure link ya token khud mat banao ya bolo — reports automatically WhatsApp par bheje jaate hain jab ready hote hain; agar patient poochhe, sirf status batao.
- Har reply short rakho (WhatsApp message — 2-5 lines), zaroorat ho tabhi bullet points use karo.

## Tool selection tips
- Pehle "Get Hospital and Doctor Info" se doctor_id/department confirm karo, phir "Check Doctor's Booked Slots" se free slot dhoondo, tabhi "Book Appointment" call karo.
- Cancel/Reschedule tools sirf isi patient ke appointment par kaam karte hain (already secured) — appointment_id patient khud bata sakta hai ya tum "check status" se pehle nikaal sakte ho.

### 3️⃣ SECTION B — AI Voice Calling for Follow-ups (Server API)
Yahan har jagah HAMARA APNA "Voice Calling Server API" call hota hai (LiveKit/Sarvam-based apna backend) — n8n sirf trigger deta hai aur result webhook se wapas leta hai.
**Contract Dev's server ko implement karna hoga:**
`POST {VOICE_API_BASE_URL}/api/v1/calls` — body: {patient_phone, patient_name, call_type, appointment_id, context, callback_url}. Header: `Authorization: Bearer {VOICE_API_KEY}`.
Call complete hone par server WAPAS is workflow ke `voice-call-callback` webhook par POST kare: {call_id, appointment_id, patient_phone, status, outcome, transcript_summary, requested_new_time}. outcome ek in me se: confirmed | reschedule_requested | cancelled | no_answer | failed.

### 4️⃣ SECTION C — Reports & Prescription Notification
Trigger: aapka Lab/EMR system (ya manual Postman call) is webhook par POST karega jab report ready ho.
Body expected: { patient_phone OR patient_id, report_type, report_url, doctor_notes (optional), is_critical (optional bool) }.
Secure link banta hai (random token + 7-din expiry) — asli report_url kabhi WhatsApp par directly share nahi hota, sirf secure_link jo aapke report-viewer page (REPORT_PORTAL_BASE_URL) par khulta hai.

parameters.content:
### 5️⃣ SECTION D — Feedback & Review Automation (outbound trigger)
Har ghante check karta hai ki kaunse appointments 2+ ghante pehle 'completed' mark ho chuke hain aur abhi tak feedback nahi maanga gaya. Unhe WhatsApp par "1-5 reply karo" bhejta hai.
**Reply ka processing SECTION A me hota hai** (upar "Is Numeric Rating Reply With Pending Feedback?" branch) — rating<=3 par front-desk escalate, rating>=4 par Google review request.
NOTE: `appointments.status = 'completed'` set karna aapke front-desk/EMR system ki responsibility hai (jab visit khatam ho).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ appointment_id: $json.id, patient_id: $json.patient.id, patient_phone: $json.patient.phone, rating: null, requested_at: new Date().toISOString() }]) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ feedback_sent: true }) }}

(n8n rule: ek workflow khud apna error-catcher nahi ho sakti — yeh UI-only setting hai, JSON import se set nahi hoti.)
